claims.head: Best against best
claims.body: The Kings are near the top of the league for shot volume, and the Panthers are one of the league’s best at keeping shots away. We think the Panthers win this one.
claims.call: The Panthers keep the Kings under the league-average 56.9 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5.
claims.nums: Los Angeles 7th for shot volume (60.3 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5) · Florida 2nd for keeping shots away
claims.gist: It’s strength against strength: the Kings for shot volume, the Panthers at keeping shots away.
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 2 and 3 games this season

check.measure: 5-on-5 shot attempts per 60, adjusted for score and venue
check.rule: held if tonight's figure lands on the predicted side of the league average; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: Bruisers against finesse
claims.body: On physicality, Florida is the league’s best and Los Angeles is near the bottom of the league. That’s about as far apart as two teams get.
claims.gist: The Panthers and the Kings sit at opposite ends for physicality.
claims.call: The Panthers hit more than the Kings in the close stretches of the game.
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 3 and 2 games this season

check.measure: hit score in close games (arena-adjusted, 100 is league average)
check.rule: held if the team comes out ahead by at least half its usual margin; partly if it comes out ahead by less; otherwise didn't happen

LAK.head: Too close to call
LAK.body: Los Angeles has had more of the chances over recent games and has home ice. For Los Angeles, the difference could be keeping dangerous shots away.

FLA.head: A genuine toss-up
FLA.body: Los Angeles has had more of the chances over recent games and has home ice. For Florida, the difference could be keeping dangerous shots away.

story.head: Round two in Los Angeles
paras: The Panthers already came to Los Angeles once this season and left with a 2-1 win. The Kings haven’t won in three. The Panthers are 2-0-2.
It’s strength against strength: the Kings for shot volume, the Panthers at keeping shots away. The Panthers and the Kings sit at opposite ends for physicality.

items.text: Brad Marchand has four goals in six games against Los Angeles since 2023-24.
Artemi Panarin has five goals in eight games against Florida since 2023-24, most of them with the Rangers.
Aaron Ekblad has missed the Panthers’ last two games.
Sam Reinhart is still looking for his first goal of the season.
